Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished, distinctive high-fidelity UI design for Noor Academy, an academy management and class materials platform. Style: refined editorial warmth plus quiet functional UI. Color system: page #F7F5EF, surface #FFFFFF, primary forest #163D35, primary-hover #0F2D27, pale sage #E8F0EB, brass decoration #B58A43, text #182924, muted #52635B, border #DCE3DC. Typography: Lora-like restrained literary serif for public hero headlines and wordmark, Inter-like precise sans serif for all interface text. Modest 12-16 px radii, fine rules, abundant whitespace, balanced grid, 44 px touch targets. Flat front-on actual web UI, no perspective, no device mockup, no floating composition, no gradients behind the whole screen, no glows, no glossy 3D. Brand motif: a simple thin brass rising-light semicircle above a short green horizontal stroke, alongside text "noor academy"; provisional new identity. Decorative learning illustration may show blank books and a quiet light arch, but never pretend to depict a real academy facility or use sacred text. All subject, teacher, room, seat, and schedule data are demonstration data. No prices, online checkout, ratings, invented testimonials, counts, accreditation, course difficulty, progress bars, messaging, video calls, submissions or grading. English only. Business rule: application is pending until administrator confirms after manual payment, pending expires 72 hours after application, seat not guaranteed. Need a beautifully composed professional design, crisp and readable text.
Asset type: flagship public homepage, full-page desktop web design. Generate a single tall portrait artboard, approximately 1440 by 2400 proportions, at high resolution. Screen content fills almost all canvas with a very thin neutral outer border.
Header: symbol and "noor academy" left, "Courses" and "How enrollment works" center, "Sign in" and small forest "Explore courses" right. An unobtrusive slim label "DESIGN CONCEPT · DEMONSTRATION CATALOG".
Hero on ivory: left 56% huge elegant dark-green serif headline over three considered lines "A brighter path / to learning." below eyebrow "LEARN WITH CLARITY". Supporting text exactly "Explore our courses, choose a class that fits your schedule, and keep your learning materials in one place." Primary green button "Explore courses", secondary underlined "How enrollment works". Right 40% sophisticated editorial sculptural still-life illustration: cream blank-page open book, stacked closed sage volumes, single warm brass sun disc and soft arch-shaped light, paper grain; explicitly an illustration, not a photo of a facility. Plenty of whitespace.
Narrow full-width benefit strip with 3 line icons and text "Scheduled group classes", "Teacher-led learning", "Resources in one place".
Next course section: asymmetric header "Find your next / chapter." in serif left and right text "Explore the demonstration catalog." Four beautiful two-column course entries with fine top rules and small abstract geometry thumbnail blocks (not real course covers): Quran Memorization; Arabic Language Fundamentals; Islamic Studies; Tajweed Mastery. Each has one short product-appropriate description and "View available groups →". Avoid four identical heavy rounded cards.
Next soft sage section "A clear path into your class." 3 numbered steps in an open horizontal layout: "01 Choose your group" short "Compare schedules, teachers and availability."; "02 Apply and arrange payment" short "Your application is pending for up to 72 hours."; "03 Receive confirmation" short "An administrator confirms your enrollment after payment." Below subtle amber outlined note "An application does not guarantee a seat."
Next ivory two-column study-experience section: left "Less searching. / More learning." body "Your weekly schedule and class resources, together." Right a precise labeled "ILLUSTRATIVE WORKSPACE" preview showing one upcoming class and three rows "Lesson · Reading practice", "Exercise · Practice sheet", "Correction · Guided answers". No progress, grades or live video.
Finish deep-green band "Your next chapter starts here." with pale button "Explore courses". Footer minimal wordmark and "Courses", "Sign in"; microcopy "Contact and policy links require owner-provided content."
Make it sophisticated enough for a premium brand presentation while believable as an implementable website. Prioritize exact text hierarchy and visual alignment.
